style: Documentary photograph, real and unstaged, natural warm light, shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens, true-to-life colors, gentle film grain. No people, no hands, no vehicles, no text, no logos, no brand names on any equipment.
items: h1-colonial-16x9

Golden hour in late October: a white two-story center-hall colonial house in Trumbull, Connecticut with black shutters, a stone front walk and maple trees in warm orange autumn color. Low sun from the left, long soft shadows, a few leaves on the lawn, windows glowing faintly. Eye level from the street. Wide composition with the house on the right two-thirds and open sky and trees on the left.

Early evening in January just after a light snowfall: a gray-shingled Cape Cod house in a Fairfield County, Connecticut neighborhood, every window glowing warm amber, a lamp-lit front porch, a thin wisp of chimney exhaust, fresh snow on the roof and the evergreen shrubs. Deep blue twilight sky balanced by strong warm window light. Wide composition with the house on the right and snowy yard on the left.

Late afternoon inside a cozy Connecticut living room: a slim white wall-mounted ductless mini-split indoor unit high on a pale wall, a linen sofa with a knit throw, wide-plank oak floor, a reading lamp, tall windows showing orange autumn trees outside, warm sunlight raking across the room. Calm, lived-in, tidy. Wide composition with the mini-split upper right.

A tidy basement utility area in a Connecticut home with a newly installed high-efficiency gas furnace: a clean light-gray cabinet, white PVC intake and exhaust pipes, new silver sheet-metal ductwork, a fresh condensate line, swept concrete floor, warm work-light glow from the left. Wide composition with the furnace right of center.

A fieldstone-foundation basement in an older Connecticut home with a newly installed oil-fired cast-iron boiler: neat copper and black-iron piping, a small circulator pump, insulated pipes, a clean oil tank to the side, warm light from a basement window. Wide composition, the boiler right of center.

Golden hour in October beside a white clapboard house in Connecticut: a modern heat pump outdoor unit on a clean composite pad, neat line set running up the wall in a white cover, mulch bed with fallen maple leaves, warm low sun. Wide composition with the unit on the right third.

Morning light in a calm Connecticut bedroom: a slim white ductless mini-split indoor unit mounted above the window, a made bed with white linen and a wool blanket, wood nightstand with a lamp, soft warm sunlight through sheer curtains. Wide composition.

A clean basement corner in a Connecticut home with a newly installed 50-gallon tank water heater, new copper water lines with shutoff valves, a small expansion tank, a drain pan, warm light from the side, swept concrete floor.

Yearly tune-up scene in a tidy basement: a gas furnace with its front panel neatly set aside, a fresh white pleated air filter leaning against the cabinet next to the old gray one, an open canvas tool bag, a flashlight and a digital combustion analyzer resting on a clean drop cloth. Warm work light.

Close documentary detail of a furnace repair in progress: the furnace cabinet open showing the blower and control board, a digital multimeter with test leads, insulated screwdrivers and a nut driver laid out on a canvas drop cloth, warm work light, shallow depth of field.

A warm July evening beside a brick ranch house in Fairfield County, Connecticut: a central air conditioning condenser on a level pad, blue hydrangeas in bloom, green lawn, soft golden sunlight. Wide composition with the condenser on the right third.

Morning light across a farmhouse kitchen table in a Connecticut home: a mug of coffee, an open folder with printed heating system options and a hand-written notepad with a few line items, a pen, a window with autumn trees behind. The feeling of a calm, no-pressure conversation about options.
